trust_boundary: Packaged manifest and managed Python environment are trusted. Verify all artifact bytes before deserialization; Smule source is compiled from verified bytes, not imported from its directory. No downloads or installation occur in this adapter. Model directory must remain read-only during inference.
dependency_policy: These are direct version constraints, not approval of an unresolved wheel graph. Root builder owns the complete tested lock, hashes and third-party notices, including separate GPU vendor terms.

umxhq-mit.weights_evidence: Original authors weight deposit metadata.license.id is mit-license. Applies to UMX-HQ, not UMXL.
